caption: Corniglia clifftop, Corniglia
composition: Clifftop village above terraced vineyards and the Lardarina staircase · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the sea side the camera faces the clifftop village on the right, its church and bell tower rising above the houses. The long Lardarina staircase zigzags down the cliff at center-left, terraced vineyards step down the right slopes, and the calm blue sea fills the left. The 08:20 morning sun warms the stone and the green.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Corniglia on its cliff under mainly clear morning light
